source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 20 exercise solved (PDF 166-168): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Biotechnology) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb aur kitab ke numbers ke saath (MCQs 1-10; short 25-30, long 32-35 aur inquisitive 13-17, kyun ke kitab yahan chapter 19 se numbering jari rakhti hai). Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Identify the FALSE statement.
(GHALAT bayan pehchanein.)

options.text: RFLPs banane ke liye restriction enzyme istemal hota hai.
DNA ligase DNA ko kaat kar sticky ends banata hai.
Reverse transcriptase mRNA se cDNA banata hai.
Electrophoresis ka matlab DNA ke tukron ko alag karna hai.

blocks.explanation: DNA ligase DNA ke tukre jorta hai (molecular glue, gond); DNA kaat kar sticky ends restriction endonuclease banata hai (20.2.1). Baqi bayanat durust hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. Which bacterium is used in the production of insulin by genetic engineering?
(Genetic engineering se insulin banane mein kaun sa bacterium istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insulin ki chain A aur chain B wale recombinant plasmids Escherichia coli ke do cultures mein dale jate hain jo chains banate hain (20.5). Saccharomyces yeast (khameer) hai, bacterium nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (b) ka label "b) Rhizobium" chhapa hai, "(b)" ka pehla bracket reh gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Which technique is used for cloning of gene/DNA?
(Gene/DNA ki cloning (hu-ba-hu copies banana) ke liye kaun si technique istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: PCR gene of interest ki bohat si hu-ba-hu copies banata hai: 20 cycles mein ek tukre se das lakh se zyada copies (20.3). Electroporation sirf gene ko cell mein dakhil karta hai; RFLP aur electrophoresis DNA ka jaiza ya alag karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
4. Which method is used for obtaining the gene of interest?
(Gene of interest hasil karne ka kaun sa tareeqa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gene of interest lab mein seedha banaya ja sakta hai, us ke mRNA ki reverse transcription se banaya ja sakta hai, ya restriction endonucleases se chromosome se kaata ja sakta hai (20.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
5. When a gene of interest is attached to the vector, the new molecule is called;
(Jab gene of interest vector se jor diya jaye to naye molecule ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gene of interest vector se jurta hai aur vector recombinant DNA (rDNA) ban jata hai (20.2.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein "Complimentary" chhapa hai; durust lafz "Complementary DNA" (cDNA) hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. What is the use of plasmid in genetic engineering?
(Genetic engineering mein plasmid ka kya kaam hai?)

options.text: DNA ko cell tak le jana

blocks.explanation: Plasmids sab se aam vectors (molecular carrier, le jane wale) hain jo gene of interest ko host cell tak le jate hain (20.2.1). Kaatna restriction enzymes aur jorna DNA ligase ka kaam hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of these can serve as ideal expression system for gene cloning?
(Gene cloning ke liye behtareen expression system kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacterial cells behtareen expression system hain kyun ke un ki nasal jaldi badalti hai (short generation time) aur genetic nizam saada hai (20.2.1). Bacteriophages vector hain, host nahi.

blocks.prompt:
8. In PCR, optimum temperature for carrying out the extension of primer is;
(PCR mein primer ki extension (lamba karne) ke liye behtareen temperature kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Taq polymerase se extension 72°C par behtareen hai aur taqreeban ek minute leti hai; 98°C denaturation (strands alag karne) aur taqreeban 60°C annealing (primer jurne) ke liye hai (20.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
9. Which enzyme is used for the extension of primer in PCR?
(PCR mein primer ki extension ke liye kaun sa enzyme istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Garmi bardasht karne wala DNA polymerase, yani Taq polymerase (Thermus aquaticus se), primer ke 3′ sire par nucleotides jorta hai (20.3.1).

blocks.prompt:
10. What is true for a Genetically Modified Organism
(Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) ke bare mein kya durust hai?)
blocks.explanation: GMO woh jandar hai jis ka genome badla gaya ho; genetic engineering mein genes dakhil karna, nikalna ya tabdeel karna sab shamil hai (20.1, 20.4).

blocks.prompt:
25. What is the role of restriction endonucleases and DNA ligases in gene cloning?
Gene cloning mein restriction endonucleases aur DNA ligases ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Restriction endonucleases (molecular scissors, qainchi) DNA ko khaas palindromic restriction sites par kaat kar sticky ends banate hain; ek hi enzyme gene of interest bhi kaat'ta aur vector bhi kholta hai, is liye sire mil jate hain.
DNA ligase (molecular glue, gond) phosphodiester bonds bana kar gene of interest ko kate hue vector mein jorta hai aur recombinant DNA banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
26. What is the role of vectors in recombinant DNA technology?
Recombinant DNA technology mein vectors ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation: Vectors (molecular carriers, le jane wale) gene of interest ko host cell tak le jate hain. Gene vector se jur kar recombinant DNA banta hai jo host mein ja kar copy (clone) aur express hota hai. Plasmids sab se aam; doosre: bacteriophages, cosmids, BACs, YACs, P1 artificial chromosomes aur animal viruses. Plasmid ke antibiotic-resistance aur lacZ' genes screening mein madad dete hain.

blocks.prompt:
27. Describe how the gene of interest is selected and isolated during recombinant DNA technology.
Recombinant DNA technology mein gene of interest kaise chuna aur alag kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Gene of interest woh gene hai jis mein kaam karna hai (maslan insulin gene). Yeh teen tareeqon mein se kisi se milta hai:
1. Lab mein enzymes (polymerases, ligases) se seedha banana.
2. Us ke mRNA ki reverse transcriptase se reverse transcription (cDNA).
3. Restriction endonucleases se chromosome se kaatna, jo khaas jagah kaat kar sticky ends chhorte hain.
Cloning ke baad gene wali colonies radioactive DNA probe (DNA hybridization) se pehchani jati hain.

blocks.prompt:
28. State the steps for the integration of gene of interest into the vector.
Gene of interest ko vector mein jorne ke qadam bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. DNA kaatna: source DNA ko restriction endonuclease se kaat kar gene of interest alag kiya jata hai.
2. Vector DNA (plasmid) ko usi endonuclease se kaata jata hai taake milte julte sticky ends banein.
3. Kata vector aur gene DNA ligase ke saath rakhe jate hain jo phosphodiester bonds se inhein jor kar recombinant vector banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
29. State the role of GMO in making biotechnology products.
Biotechnology products banane mein GMO ka kirdar bataein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Transgenic bacteria: insulin, clotting factors, hepatitis B aur Covid-19 vaccines, growth hormone, interferon, erythropoietin, tissue plasminogen activator; khane ke enzymes (alpha-amylase, chymosin, pectin-esterase); aaloodgi (pollution) torne wale enzymes.
2. Transgenic janwar: insani doodh jaisa doodh, bakri ke doodh mein makri ke resham jaise proteins aur lysozyme, bakri se khoon jamne se rokne wali dawa (anticoagulant).
3. Transgenic paude: Bt fasalein, herbicide se na marne wali fasalein, golden rice, aur biopharmaceuticals (hormones, antibodies, vaccines).
Ek DNA kaat'ta hai, doosra jorta hai.

rows: DNA kaat'ta hai (qainchi)
DNA ke tukre jorta hai (gond)
Khaas restriction site par phosphodiester bonds torta hai
Saath wale nucleotides mein phosphodiester bonds banata hai
Sticky ends banata hai
Gene aur vector ke sticky ends jorta hai
Gene alag karne aur vector kholne ke liye
Recombinant DNA banane ke liye

blocks.explanation: Dono genetic engineering ke bunyadi auzaar hain.

rows: DNA ke chhote hisse ki bohat si copies
Ek source ka DNA kaat kar doosre mein jorna
Test tube mein; zinda host nahi
Vector aur zinda host cell
Primers, Taq polymerase, nucleotides, garam thanda karne ke cycles
Restriction enzymes, ligase, vectors
Nateeja: ek hi DNA ki copies
Nateeja: recombinant DNA aur us ka protein (maslan insulin)

blocks.prompt:
32. Describe the components and steps of recombinant DNA technology.
Recombinant DNA technology ke ajza (components) aur qadam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Recombinant DNA technology mukhtalif sources ke DNA ko kaat kar, jor kar ek hybrid molecule banana aur use host mein dal kar naye gene combinations ya proteins banana hai.
Ajza (auzaar):
1. Gene of interest: lab mein banana, mRNA ki reverse transcription, ya chromosome se kaatna.
2. Restriction endonucleases: qainchi jo khaas palindromic sites (4-8 nucleotides) par kaat kar sticky ends chhorti hai.
3. Vectors: le jane wale, maslan plasmids (sab se aam), bacteriophages, cosmids, BACs, YACs, P1 artificial chromosomes, animal viruses.
4. DNA ligase: gond jo phosphodiester bonds banata hai.
5. Expression system: host (aam tor par bacteria, jaldi nasal aur saada genetics) jo gene copy aur express kare.
Qadam:
1. Recombinant vector banana: source DNA aur plasmid ek hi restriction enzyme se kaate jate hain taake sticky ends milein; DNA ligase ke saath gene plasmid mein jur jata hai.
2. Cloning: recombinant plasmid aur bacteria ek saath rakhe jate hain; bacteria plasmid le kar barhte hain aur gene ki copies wale clones bante hain.
3. Clone library ki screening: (i) antibiotic selection: sirf plasmid (antibiotic-resistance gene wale) bacteria ampicillin par ugte hain; (ii) blue-white screening: dakhil gene lacZ' gene ko tor deta hai, is liye recombinant colonies safaid aur baqi neeli; (iii) DNA hybridization: radioactive complementary probe aur autoradiography se master plate par gene wali colonies milti hain.
Misaal: E. coli mein insani insulin.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Blue-white screening asaan lafzon mein: lacZ' gene ek khaas cheeni ko neela kar deta hai. Agar hamara gene plasmid ke andar lacZ' ke beech mein baith gaya to lacZ' toot gaya, colony neeli nahi hogi, safaid rahegi. Is liye safaid colony = kamyab recombinant.

blocks.prompt:
33. Write a detailed note on restriction enzymes.
Restriction enzymes par tafseeli note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Restriction endonucleases woh enzymes hain jo DNA ki khaas nucleotide tarteeb ko kaat'te hain; inhein molecular scissors (qainchi) kehte hain.
2. In ki bohat qismein hain; har qism apni khaas tarteeb, yani restriction site (recognition region), pehchanti, wahan jurti aur site ke andar khaas jagah se DNA kaat'ti hai.
3. Restriction sites chaar se aath nucleotides ki palindromic tarteeb hain: dono strands par ulte rukh mein parhne par ek hi tarteeb (ek sire ke nucleotides doosre sire ke complementary).
4. Enzyme dono strands kaat'ta hai. Tukron ke sire chand nucleotides ke single-stranded aur aapas mein complementary hote hain: sticky ends (chipakne wale sire).
5. Ahmiyat: ek hi restriction enzyme se kate do tukron ke sticky ends milte hain aur DNA ligase se jur sakte hain. Is liye gene of interest aur vector dono ek hi enzyme se kaate jate hain aur recombinant DNA banta hai.
6. Istemal: chromosomes se gene alag karna, recombinant plasmids banana, aur DNA ke jaize ke liye RFLPs (restriction fragment length polymorphisms) banana.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Palindrome ki misaal (sirf samajhne ke liye): lafz "MADAM" ulta seedha ek jaisa parha jata hai. Isi tarah restriction site ka ek strand 5′ se 3′ aur doosra strand bhi 5′ se 3′ parhein to tarteeb ek hi hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
34. Write a note on polymerase chain reaction.
Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
PCR DNA polymerase se gene of interest ko bar bar copy kar ke bohat si hu-ba-hu copies banata hai. Kary Mullis ne 1983 mein banaya (Chemistry ka Nobel Prize, 1993).
Qadam:
1. Denaturation: DNA ke tukre ko zyada primers (20-30 nucleotides) ke saath mila kar taqreeban 98°C tak garam kiya jata hai; double strand alag ho kar single strands bante hain jo template ka kaam karte hain.
2. Annealing: mixture taqreeban 60°C tak thanda; forward aur backward primers single strands par apni complementary jagah jur jate hain.
3. Extension: garmi bardasht karne wala Taq polymerase (garam chashmon ke bacterium Thermus aquaticus se) aur chaaron nucleotides dale jate hain; enzyme har primer ke 3′ sire par nucleotides jorta hai, 72°C par taqreeban ek minute mein. Dono strands copy ho kar do copies.
4. Cycle dohrana: qadam 1-3 dohraye jate hain; naya enzyme nahi chahiye kyun ke garmi Taq polymerase ko nuqsan nahi deti. Har cycle (1-2 minute) DNA dugna karta hai; 20 cycles mein ek tukre se das lakh se zyada copies.
Istemal: bimari ke jaraseem ki tashkhees; genetic bimariyon aur cancer ki mutations dhoondna; jurm ki tafteesh mein sookhe khoon ya baal ki jar se DNA fingerprints; shuru ke embryos mein genetic naqais; khatam shuda (extinct) species ka DNA; genomic library banana.

rows: Denaturation
Taqreeban 98°C: DNA strands alag
Annealing
Taqreeban 60°C: primers complementary jagah jurte hain
Extension
72°C: Taq polymerase primers lambe karta hai

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hisaab: har cycle copies dugni karti hai, is liye n cycles ke baad copies = 2 ki taqat n. 20 cycles: 2 ki taqat 20 = 1,048,576, yani das lakh se zyada. Is liye bohat thora DNA (ek baal ki jar) bhi kafi hai.

blocks.prompt:
35. Describe the methods for the introduction of human DNA into bacteria.
Insani DNA ko bacteria mein dakhil karne ke tareeqe bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tayyari: insani gene (maslan insulin ki chain A ya B) lab mein banaya, mRNA se reverse transcriptase se banaya, ya restriction enzyme se kaata jata hai; plasmid ko usi enzyme se kaat kar DNA ligase se gene jora jata hai aur recombinant plasmid banta hai (aksar bacterial gene jaise lacZ ke saath taake bacteria use express karein).
DNA dakhil karne ke tareeqe (cell ko tabah kiye baghair):
1. Medium se le lena (transformation): recombinant plasmids aur bacteria ek hi medium mein rakhe jate hain aur bacteria plasmids le lete hain.
2. Electroporation: bijli ka current cell wall aur membrane mein surakh banata hai; DNA andar jata hai aur current band hone par surakh band.
3. Chemical tareeqe: nanga (naked) DNA kisi chemical ke saath milaya jata hai; yeh complex diffusion ya endocytosis se cytoplasm mein jata hai.
4. Virus ke zariye: bacteriophage vectors (maslan phage lambda, P1) gene ko bacterium mein le jate hain.
(Microinjection, biolistic gene gun aur protoplast tareeqe zyada tar bare plant aur animal cells ke liye hain.)
Dakhil karne ke baad recombinant plasmid wale bacteria antibiotic resistance, blue-white screening aur DNA probes se chune jate hain aur bioreactors mein paal kar insani protein banaya jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
13. Find and describe the accomplishments of the renowned genetic engineers working in private and public institutions in your province or city.
Apne soobe ya shehar ke sarkari aur nijji idaron mein kaam karne wale mashhoor genetic engineers ki kamyabiyan dhoond kar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh project wala sawal hai; jawab talib ilm ki apni talaash par hai. Model jawab (chapter se aage; tafseel maqami tor par tasdeeq karein):
Punjab mein bare markaz: National Institute for Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering (NIBGE), Faisalabad; Centre of Excellence in Molecular Biology (CEMB), Punjab University, Lahore; aur Centre of Agricultural Biochemistry and Biotechnology (CABB), University of Agriculture, Faisalabad. In ke genetic engineers ne:
1. Keeron se mehfooz transgenic (Bt) kapas aur doosri fasalon ki qismein maqami kisanon ke liye banayin.
2. Hepatitis jaisi bimariyon aur fasalon, maweshiyon ke jaraseem ke liye PCR tests banaye.
3. Insani genetic bimariyon (maslan Pakistani khandanon mein virasati behrapan aur andhapan ke genes) aur DNA fingerprinting par kaam kiya.
4. Mahireen tayyar kiye aur universities aur sanat mein biotechnology labs qaim kin.
Jawab ka tareeqa: idara aur scientist ka naam, shoba (zaraat, tib, sanat), kya banaya ya dhoonda, aur logon ko kya faida.

blocks.prompt:
14. Analyse and interpret the DNA of a child by comparing it with that of two individuals in a case of disputed parenthood.
Waldiyat (parentage) ke tanaze mein bachay ke DNA ka do afraad ke DNA se muqabla kar ke tajzia karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kitab mein DNA ke natije nahi chhape; jawab tajzie ka tareeqa hai (DNA fingerprinting; kuch hissa chapter se aage).
1. Namoone: bachay, maloom walid (maslan maa) aur dono mutnaze afraad ka DNA lein, maslan khoon ya baal ki jar ke cells se; PCR bohat thore namoone ko bhi barha deta hai (20.3).
2. Sab namoonon ke saath ek jaisa amal: DNA ke ek jaise hisse ek hi restriction enzymes se kaatein (ya PCR se barhayein) aur gel electrophoresis se tukre saath saath alag karein; har shakhs ke bands ka pattern (RFLP / DNA fingerprint) banega.
3. Kya milana hai: bacha aadha DNA maa se aur aadha baap se leta hai, is liye bachay ka har band kisi ek walid mein hona chahiye. Pehle bachay ke woh bands nishan karein jo maloom walid se milte hain; baqi bands doosre hayatiyati walid se aaye hain.
4. Faisla kaise: yeh baqi bands dono mutnaze afraad se milayein.
- Jis shakhs mein bachay ke yeh tamam baqi bands hon, woh hayatiyati walid ho sakta hai.
- Jis mein in mein se kai bands na hon, woh walid hone se kharij.
- Agar kisi mein na hon to dono mein se koi walid nahi; agar dono milte lagein to DNA ke mazeed hisse test karein.
5. Ghair rishtedar logon ke band patterns mukhtalif hote hain, is liye kai hisson mein poora milap waldiyat ka bohat mazboot saboot hai, aur wazeh farq yaqeeni tor par kharij kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
15. What may be the application of polymerase chain reaction?
Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) ke kya istemal ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Tashkhees: bohat thore namoone se bimari ke jaraseem (bacteria, viruses) ke genotype maloom karna.
2. Genetic bimariyon aur cancer ki zimmedar mutations dhoondna.
3. Jurm ki tafteesh: sookhe khoon ke zara se namoone ya ek baal ki jar se DNA fingerprints.
4. Bilkul shuru ke embryos ke chand cells se genetic naqais maloom karna.
5. Khatam shuda species ke zara se baqiyat se DNA ka mutala.
6. DNA sequencing ke liye genomic libraries, aur recombinant DNA ke kaam ke liye genes barhana.
(Chapter se aage: waldiyat ka test, jaise Q14, aur aafat mein marne walon ki shanakht.)

blocks.prompt:
16. The human genome project is regarded as the most ambitious project ever undertaken by man. Justify.
Human genome project ko insaan ka sab se bara aur buland hausla mansooba kaha jata hai. Jawaz dein.
blocks.explanation:
(Chapter se aage; chapter mein sirf genome sequencing ka zikr hai.)
1. Size: maqsad insani DNA ke taqreeban 3 arab nucleotide joron ki tarteeb parhna aur tamam insani genes (taqreeban 20,000-25,000) ki jagah maloom karna tha.
2. Wusat aur ta'awun: 1990 se 2003 tak chala; kai mulkon ke scientists, labs aur hukoomaton ne mil kar kaam kiya; kharch taqreeban 3 arab US dollar.
3. Technology: tez automatic DNA sequencing, PCR wale tareeqe aur bara data sambhalne ke computer auzaar (bioinformatics) bane.
4. Fawaid: bimari ke genes dhoondne, genetic testing, gene therapy, pharmacogenomics (shakhs ke genes ke mutabiq dawa) aur insani evolution ke mutale ka naqsha mila.
5. Data sab ke liye muft diya gaya, aur naye akhlaqi, qanooni aur samaji sawal uthe jin ka mutala bhi zaroori hua.
Is ke size, kharch, bain-ul-aqwami teamwork aur biology aur tib par lambe asar ki wajah se ise sab se bara mansooba kaha jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
17. Investigate careers that require an understanding of biotechnology and genetic engineering.
Aise peshon (careers) ki talaash karein jin ke liye biotechnology aur genetic engineering ki samajh zaroori hai.
blocks.explanation:
(Project wala sawal; fehrist aam maloomat se, chapter se aage.)
1. Research scientist / molecular biologist: universities aur idaron (maslan NIBGE, CEMB) mein.
2. Dawa sazi (pharmaceutical) mein genetic engineer: insulin, vaccines, hormones, monoclonal antibodies.
3. Zaraati biotechnologist / plant breeder: transgenic (Bt, herbicide-resistant) fasalein.
4. Clinical aur diagnostic lab scientist: infections aur genetic bimariyon ke PCR tests.
5. Forensic DNA analyst: jurm aur waldiyat ke muqadmat mein DNA fingerprinting.
6. Genetic counsellor: genetic bimari wale khandanon ko mashwara.
7. Bioinformatician: computer se genome ke data ka tajzia.
8. Food aur industrial biotechnologist: enzymes (amylase, chymosin), fermentation, aaloodgi saaf karna (bioremediation).
9. Animal biotechnologist aur veterinary scientist: transgenic janwar, maweshiyon ki vaccines.
10. Biosafety, regulatory aur patent officers, aur science teachers.

items: Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ 2 option (b) ka label "b)" (bracket reh gaya); MCQ 5 option (c) "Complimentary" yani "Complementary".
Short (6 sawal, Q30 ke 2 jore alag alag), long (4) aur inquisitive (5) sawalon ke model jawab upar hain; inquisitive Q13, Q16, Q17 project wale hain aur jawab chapter se aage hain.
